# baysaass — Brand Designer & Visual Systems Studio

> Premium brand identity, packaging design, and visual systems by Т. Өсөхбаяр (baysaass), based in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

## About
- **Designer**: Т. Өсөхбаяр (baysaass)
- **Role**: Brand Designer, Visual Systems Specialist & Creative Director
- **Location**: Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia (Serves domestic & international clients)
- **Email**: baysaauskhuu@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://baysaass.space

## Core Services
1. **Brand Identity Design**: Comprehensive visual identity, brand strategy, primary & secondary logos, responsive marks, color systems, and comprehensive brand guidelines books.
2. **Packaging & Label Design**: FMCG, beverage, cosmetic, and artisanal product packaging, 3D mockups, material selection, foil/emboss specs, and production-ready dielines.
3. **Typography & Visual Systems**: Custom Cyrillic and Latin lettering, editorial typography, layout hierarchies, and brand design systems.
4. **Brand Collateral & Digital Assets**: Business stationery, presentation decks, social media toolkits, and marketing collateral.

## Selected Portfolio Projects
- **Arhan**: Modern Mongolian hospitality & dining visual identity.
- **Buramhan**: Artisanal confectionery brand identity and custom packaging.
- **Broncos**: Athletic sports brand identity and apparel graphics.
- **Zen Tarot**: Editorial packaging, candle label system, and mystical card design.
- **BeautyTech**: Minimalist technology-driven cosmetic brand system.
- **CAE**: Architectural and engineering corporate identity.
- **Chandmani Goyol**: Fine jewelry packaging and timeless brand marks.
- **Endeno**: Organic beverage label and bottling packaging.
- **Naadam Typography**: Contemporary typographic exploration of traditional Mongolian festivals.

## Client Onboarding & Project Workflow
- **Phase 1: Project Inquiry & AI Brief**: Client submits brief through https://baysaass.space/contact or direct inquiry.
- **Phase 2: Strategy & Moodboard**: In-depth competitor analysis, positioning, and visual moodboards.
- **Phase 3: Design Exploration**: 2–3 distinct creative directions presented in high-fidelity mockups.
- **Phase 4: Refinement & System Expansion**: Selected concept refined into a comprehensive design system.
- **Phase 5: Production Handover & Guidelines**: Delivery of vector files (AI, EPS, SVG), font pairings, color codes (Pantone/CMYK/RGB/HEX), print dielines, and client portal tracking.
